title: Weft project file (weft.json)
description: Shared resources and tool settings of a Weft project (SPEC §10). Every member is optional; an argument given to a tool overrides the file, and the file overrides the defaults.

$schema.description: This schema, for editors. Ignored by Weft.

tokens.description: DTCG token files, in layer order: a later file overrides an earlier one (SPEC §10.3).

catalog.description: A catalog that extends the core catalog with the project's kinds, props and variants (SPEC §10.4).

actions.description: The host's action names; on-* values are checked against them.

data.description: A JSON Schema of the host data model; bindings are checked against it (SPEC §10.5).

mode.description: "strict" reports unknown elements and attributes as errors, "lenient" as warnings (SPEC §8). Used by `weft validate` and as the default of weft_validate's strict argument.

write.description: Rewrite the file in place instead of printing it.

format.description: How `weft fmt` writes the canonical form. The form itself has no options (SPEC §3).

data.description: Sample data file the bindings read, relative to the project file. Default: no data.

tokens.description: DTCG token files to render with, in layer order; they replace the project's tokens. Default: the project's tokens.

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

render.description: Static HTML pages from screens (`write-page`, the Claude Code plugin's render).

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

source.description: Keep the canonical screen in a leading comment, so the importer gives it back exactly instead of reading the code by convention.

data.description: Sample data (a JSON file, relative to the project file) the page shows: bindings read it and `<each>` repeats over it. Default: none, the page is a template for a host to fill.

html.description: Static HTML pages with CSS and no script (`weft html`).

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

typescript.description: Write TSX with typed props instead of JSX.

source.description: Keep the canonical screen in a leading comment, so the importer gives it back exactly instead of reading the code by convention.

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

typescript.description: Write TSX with typed props instead of JSX.

source.description: Keep the canonical screen in a leading comment, so the importer gives it back exactly instead of reading the code by convention.

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

data.description: Sample data (a JSON file, relative to the project file) the generated model is built from in a `sample` property that `#Preview` shows. Default: none, the preview shows the model's defaults.

sharedTokens.description: Screens read the tokens from one shared `WeftTokens.swift` (`weft swiftui-tokens`) instead of each carrying the tokens it uses.

swiftui.description: SwiftUI views for iOS 17 and macOS 14 (`weft swiftui`).

export.description: Code generated from screens, one section per target.

outDir.description: Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

Directory, relative to the project file, that output files go to. Default: next to the input file.

import.description: Screens imported from other formats, one section per source.

markupChars.description: UTF-16 code units of one markup argument.

dataChars.description: UTF-16 code units of the JSON of weft_render's data argument.

patchesChars.description: UTF-16 code units of the JSON of one patch list.

projectChars.description: UTF-16 code units of the JSON of a project argument.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics listed in one result; the rest are counted.

inputElements.description: JSON values in one call's arguments.

limits.description: Bounds on what one tool call may ask of the server.

mcp.description: The MCP server, when the host starts it with this project file. A project passed as a tool argument never changes these.

tokensDir.description: Folder, relative to the project file, that the plugin's design-md script writes mapped tokens to. Default: next to the design system.

plugins.description: Settings of plugins, one object per plugin name. The plugins listed here are checked; the content of any other is not.

fileName.description: Relative to the project file, separated by "/", inside the project directory.
